## Security verdict: PASS WITH NOTES

PR #215 at **952f305936f4596366ccf9b322f11be0cfaaf357**. Fix-only verification under C34's normal-use exception, not another full review round. **S215-002 is closed.** Prior S215-001 closure and other accepted qualifications carry forward.

The feature fix is `7b0d19bd51253b07fcbead65e6ae3c1e2b8c03ef`; `811edd3f44f6cf7da1dd19b3d54a1cb35f9508a0` merges main, and the final commit fixes test dialog timing. Imported main features were not re-audited.

**Three outcomes now distinguish evidence from uncertainty** (`crates/daemon/src/cheap_return.rs:228-283`):

- An observable settings transition to the return model records that model; this wins even with mixed homes.
- With no witness, an already-target saved default makes the outcome unconfirmed. The registry model becomes `None`, not falsely Sonnet.
- Only fully observable, unchanged homes retain Sonnet.

The audit separately records `returned`, `unconfirmed`, `last_confirmed_model`, reason and restoration errors (`288-315`). A failed restoration write does not erase the transition already observed. Snapshot-before-submission, composer ownership, dialog checks and restoration-before-classification remain (`173-228`; `http/revive.rs:617-681`).

The regression queues the dialog after `/model` submission and checks confirmation, unknown registry model, unconfirmed audit, last-confirmed Sonnet, absence of the false “stays on Sonnet” claim, and byte-identical settings (`cheap_return.rs:582-647`).
